import Mathlib

namespace FNDS

abbrev ByteSlice := List UInt8
abbrev ByteArray8 := ByteSlice
abbrev TreeId := ByteSlice
abbrev TreePath := List Nat
abbrev AssocMap (κ : Type) (α : Type) := List (κ × α)
abbrev StringHashMap (α : Type) := AssocMap String α
abbrev ByteMap (α : Type) := AssocMap ByteSlice α
abbrev NatMap (α : Type) := AssocMap Nat α

namespace AssocMap

variable {κ α : Type} [DecidableEq κ]

def empty : AssocMap κ α := []

def size (m : AssocMap κ α) : Nat :=
  m.length

def get : AssocMap κ α → κ → Option α
  | [], _ => none
  | (k, v) :: xs, key =>
      if k = key then some v else get xs key

def contains (m : AssocMap κ α) (key : κ) : Bool :=
  match get m key with
  | some _ => true
  | none => false

def erase : AssocMap κ α → κ → AssocMap κ α
  | [], _ => []
  | (k, v) :: xs, key =>
      if k = key then erase xs key else (k, v) :: erase xs key

def put (m : AssocMap κ α) (key : κ) (value : α) : AssocMap κ α :=
  (key, value) :: erase m key

def keys (m : AssocMap κ α) : List κ :=
  m.map Prod.fst

def values (m : AssocMap κ α) : List α :=
  m.map Prod.snd

end AssocMap

def natToByteSliceFixed : Nat → Nat → ByteSlice
  | 0, _ => []
  | n + 1, value => UInt8.ofNat (value % 256) :: natToByteSliceFixed n (value / 256)

def natToByteSlice8 (n : Nat) : ByteSlice :=
  natToByteSliceFixed 8 n

def natToTreeId (n : Nat) : TreeId :=
  natToByteSliceFixed 32 n

def zeroByteArray8 : ByteArray8 :=
  natToByteSliceFixed 8 0

def canonicalNaNByteArray8 : ByteArray8 :=
  [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 248, 127]

def byteHash : ByteSlice → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | b :: bs => b.toNat + 257 * byteHash bs

def stringByteHash (s : String) : Nat :=
  byteHash s.data.toList.map Char.toUInt8

def stableF64Bytes (x : Float) : ByteArray8 :=
  if x.isNaN then
    canonicalNaNByteArray8
  else if x = 0 then
    zeroByteArray8
  else
    natToByteSlice8 (hash x)

def take32 (bs : ByteSlice) : ByteSlice :=
  bs.take 32

def combineSignature (id data : ByteSlice) (weight scale : Float) : ByteSlice :=
  take32 (id ++ data ++ stableF64Bytes weight ++ stableF64Bytes scale)

structure FNDSStatistics where
  total_trees : Nat
  total_indices : Nat
  cache_hits : Nat
  cache_misses : Nat
  average_tree_depth : Float
  memory_used : Nat
  total_nodes_across_trees : Nat
  total_patterns_indexed : Nat
  cache_hit_ratio : Float
  last_operation_time_ns : Int
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def FNDSStatistics.init : FNDSStatistics :=
  { total_trees := 0
    total_indices := 0
    cache_hits := 0
    cache_misses := 0
    average_tree_depth := 0
    memory_used := 0
    total_nodes_across_trees := 0
    total_patterns_indexed := 0
    cache_hit_ratio := 0
    last_operation_time_ns := 0 }

def FNDSStatistics.updateCacheHitRatio (s : FNDSStatistics) : FNDSStatistics :=
  let total := s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses
  { s with cache_hit_ratio := if total = 0 then 0 else Float.ofNat s.cache_hits / Float.ofNat total }

def FNDSStatistics.recordCacheHit (s : FNDSStatistics) : FNDSStatistics :=
  FNDSStatistics.updateCacheHitRatio { s with cache_hits := s.cache_hits + 1 }

def FNDSStatistics.recordCacheMiss (s : FNDSStatistics) : FNDSStatistics :=
  FNDSStatistics.updateCacheHitRatio { s with cache_misses := s.cache_misses + 1 }

def FNDSStatistics.updateAverageTreeDepth (s : FNDSStatistics) (totalDepth treeCount : Nat) : FNDSStatistics :=
  { s with average_tree_depth := if treeCount = 0 then 0 else Float.ofNat totalDepth / Float.ofNat treeCount }

structure FractalNodeData where
  id : ByteSlice
  data : ByteSlice
  weight : Float
  scale : Float
  fractal_signature : ByteSlice
  children_count : Nat
  metadata : StringHashMap ByteSlice
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def FractalNodeData.init (id data : ByteSlice) (weight scale : Float) : FractalNodeData :=
  { id := id
    data := data
    weight := weight
    scale := scale
    fractal_signature := combineSignature id data weight scale
    children_count := 0
    metadata := [] }

def FractalNodeData.clone (n : FractalNodeData) : FractalNodeData :=
  n

def FractalNodeData.setMetadata (n : FractalNodeData) (key : String) (value : ByteSlice) : FractalNodeData :=
  { n with metadata := AssocMap.put n.metadata key value }

def FractalNodeData.getMetadata (n : FractalNodeData) (key : String) : Option ByteSlice :=
  AssocMap.get n.metadata key

def FractalNodeData.computeHash (n : FractalNodeData) : Nat :=
  byteHash n.id + byteHash n.data + byteHash n.fractal_signature + hash n.weight + hash n.scale + n.children_count +
    (n.metadata.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + stringByteHash kv.1 + byteHash kv.2) 0)

def FractalNodeData.estimateMemoryUsage (n : FractalNodeData) : Nat :=
  6 + n.id.length + n.data.length + n.fractal_signature.length +
    (n.metadata.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.1.length + kv.2.length) 0)

inductive EdgeType where
  | hierarchical
  | sibling
  | cross_level
  | self_similar
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

structure FractalEdgeData where
  source_id : ByteSlice
  target_id : ByteSlice
  weight : Float
  scale_ratio : Float
  edge_type : EdgeType
  fractal_correlation : Float
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def FractalEdgeData.init (source_id target_id : ByteSlice) (weight scale_ratio : Float) (edge_type : EdgeType) : FractalEdgeData :=
  { source_id := source_id
    target_id := target_id
    weight := weight
    scale_ratio := scale_ratio
    edge_type := edge_type
    fractal_correlation := 1 }

def FractalEdgeData.clone (e : FractalEdgeData) : FractalEdgeData :=
  e

def FractalEdgeData.estimateMemoryUsage (e : FractalEdgeData) : Nat :=
  5 + e.source_id.length + e.target_id.length

structure FractalLevel where
  level : Nat
  path : TreePath
  scale_factor : Float
  nodes : ByteMap FractalNodeData
  edges : ByteMap (List FractalEdgeData)
  children : NatMap FractalLevel
  node_count : Nat
  edge_count : Nat
  fractal_dimension : Float
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace FractalLevel

partial def getDepth (lvl : FractalLevel) : Nat :=
  1 + lvl.children.foldl (fun acc kv => Nat.max acc (getDepth kv.2)) 0

partial def getTotalNodeCount (lvl : FractalLevel) : Nat :=
  lvl.node_count + lvl.children.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + getTotalNodeCount kv.2) 0

partial def containsNodeInSubtree (lvl : FractalLevel) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Bool :=
  match AssocMap.get lvl.nodes node_id with
  | some _ => true
  | none => lvl.children.any (fun kv => containsNodeInSubtree kv.2 node_id)

partial def removeReferencesEverywhere (lvl : FractalLevel) (node_id : ByteSlice) : FractalLevel :=
  let newEdges :=
    lvl.edges.foldl
      (fun acc kv =>
        let remaining := kv.2.filter (fun e => e.target_id ≠ node_id)
        if remaining.isEmpty then acc else AssocMap.put acc kv.1 remaining)
      ([] : ByteMap (List FractalEdgeData))
  let newNodes :=
    lvl.nodes.map fun kv =>
      let kept := (AssocMap.get newEdges kv.1).getD []
      let updated := { kv.2 with children_count := kept.length }
      (kv.1, updated)
  let newChildren := lvl.children.map (fun kv => (kv.1, removeReferencesEverywhere kv.2 node_id))
  { lvl with
    nodes := newNodes
    edges := newEdges
    children := newChildren
    edge_count := newEdges.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.2.length) 0 }

partial def estimateMemoryUsage (lvl : FractalLevel) : Nat :=
  8 +
    lvl.nodes.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.1.length + kv.2.estimateMemoryUsage) 0 +
    lvl.edges.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.1.length + kv.2.foldl (fun inner e => inner + e.estimateMemoryUsage) 0) 0 +
    lvl.children.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + estimateMemoryUsage kv.2) 0

partial def collectNodes (lvl : FractalLevel) : List (Nat × FractalNodeData) :=
  let here := lvl.nodes.map (fun kv => (lvl.level, kv.2))
  let below := lvl.children.foldl (fun acc kv => acc ++ collectNodes kv.2) []
  here ++ below

partial def collectEdges (lvl : FractalLevel) : List (Nat × FractalEdgeData) :=
  let here := lvl.edges.foldl (fun acc kv => acc ++ kv.2.map (fun e => (lvl.level, e))) []
  let below := lvl.children.foldl (fun acc kv => acc ++ collectEdges kv.2) []
  here ++ below

def init (level : Nat) (scale_factor : Float) (path : TreePath := []) : FractalLevel :=
  { level := level
    path := path
    scale_factor := scale_factor
    nodes := []
    edges := []
    children := []
    node_count := 0
    edge_count := 0
    fractal_dimension := 0 }

def getNode (lvl : FractalLevel) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Option FractalNodeData :=
  AssocMap.get lvl.nodes node_id

def getEdges (lvl : FractalLevel) (source_id : ByteSlice) : List FractalEdgeData :=
  (AssocMap.get lvl.edges source_id).getD []

def addNode (lvl : FractalLevel) (node : FractalNodeData) : Bool × FractalLevel :=
  let inserted := !AssocMap.contains lvl.nodes node.id
  let nodes' := AssocMap.put lvl.nodes node.id node
  (inserted, { lvl with nodes := nodes', node_count := if inserted then lvl.node_count + 1 else lvl.node_count })

def removeNode (lvl : FractalLevel) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Bool × FractalLevel :=
  match AssocMap.get lvl.nodes node_id with
  | none => (false, lvl)
  | some _ =>
      let nodes' := AssocMap.erase lvl.nodes node_id
      let outgoing := (AssocMap.get lvl.edges node_id).getD []
      let edges' := AssocMap.erase lvl.edges node_id
      (true, { lvl with
        nodes := nodes'
        edges := edges'
        node_count := lvl.node_count - 1
        edge_count := lvl.edge_count - outgoing.length })

def addEdge (lvl : FractalLevel) (edge : FractalEdgeData) : Except String FractalLevel :=
  let sourceExists := AssocMap.contains lvl.nodes edge.source_id
  let targetExists :=
    match edge.edge_type with
    | .cross_level => containsNodeInSubtree lvl edge.target_id
    | _ => AssocMap.contains lvl.nodes edge.target_id
  if !sourceExists ∨ !targetExists then
    .error "NodeNotFound"
  else
    let current := (AssocMap.get lvl.edges edge.source_id).getD []
    let deduped := current.filter (fun e => e.target_id ≠ edge.target_id ∨ e.edge_type ≠ edge.edge_type)
    let edges' := AssocMap.put lvl.edges edge.source_id (edge :: deduped)
    let source := (AssocMap.get lvl.nodes edge.source_id).getD (FractalNodeData.init [] [] 0 0)
    let source' := { source with children_count := (edge :: deduped).length }
    let nodes' := AssocMap.put lvl.nodes edge.source_id source'
    .ok { lvl with
      nodes := nodes'
      edges := edges'
      edge_count := edges'.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.2.length) 0 }

def removeEdge (lvl : FractalLevel) (source_id target_id : ByteSlice) : Bool × FractalLevel :=
  let current := (AssocMap.get lvl.edges source_id).getD []
  let remaining := current.filter (fun e => e.target_id ≠ target_id)
  if remaining.length = current.length then
    (false, lvl)
  else
    let edges' := if remaining.isEmpty then AssocMap.erase lvl.edges source_id else AssocMap.put lvl.edges source_id remaining
    let nodes' :=
      match AssocMap.get lvl.nodes source_id with
      | none => lvl.nodes
      | some source => AssocMap.put lvl.nodes source_id { source with children_count := remaining.length }
    (true, { lvl with nodes := nodes', edges := edges', edge_count := lvl.edge_count - (current.length - remaining.length) })

def estimateBoxCount (lvl : FractalLevel) (box_size : Nat) : Nat :=
  if box_size = 0 then
    0
  else
    let content := lvl.node_count + lvl.edge_count + lvl.children.length
    if content = 0 then 0 else (content + box_size - 1) / box_size

def computeLocalFractalDimension (lvl : FractalLevel) : Float :=
  let samples := [1, 2, 4, 8]
  let usable := samples.filter (fun box => lvl.estimateBoxCount box > 0)
  if usable.length < 2 then
    if lvl.node_count = 0 then 0 else 1
  else
    let boxAvg := usable.foldl (fun acc box => acc + Float.ofNat (lvl.estimateBoxCount box)) 0 / Float.ofNat usable.length
    boxAvg / Float.ofNat (Nat.max 1 (lvl.level + 1))

def isEmpty (lvl : FractalLevel) : Bool :=
  lvl.node_count = 0 ∧ lvl.edge_count = 0 ∧ lvl.children = []

end FractalLevel

structure FractalTree where
  root : FractalLevel
  max_depth : Nat
  branching_factor : Nat
  total_nodes : Nat
  tree_id : TreeId
  creation_time : Int
  last_modified : Int
  is_balanced : Bool
  depth_cache : Option Nat
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace FractalTree

private def scaleAtDepth (branching depth : Nat) : Float :=
  let base := Float.ofNat (Nat.max 1 branching)
  let rec loop : Nat → Float
    | 0 => 1
    | n + 1 => loop n / base
  loop depth

private def natLogCeilAux (base target current depth : Nat) : Nat :=
  if current >= target then depth else natLogCeilAux base target (current * base) (depth + 1)

private def natLogCeil (base target : Nat) : Nat :=
  if base ≤ 1 then 0 else natLogCeilAux base (Nat.max 1 target) 1 0

private def computeChildIndexWith (branching : Nat) (node_id : ByteSlice) (depth : Nat) : Nat :=
  (byteHash node_id + depth) % Nat.max 1 branching

partial def searchLevelAlongPath (branching max_depth : Nat) (node_id : ByteSlice) (lvl : FractalLevel) : Option FractalNodeData :=
  match lvl.getNode node_id with
  | some node => some node
  | none =>
      if lvl.level >= max_depth then
        none
      else
        let childIndex := computeChildIndexWith branching node_id lvl.level
        match AssocMap.get lvl.children childIndex with
        | some child => searchLevelAlongPath branching max_depth node_id child
        | none => none

partial def insertLevelAlongPath (branching : Nat) (target_level : Nat) (node : FractalNodeData) (lvl : FractalLevel) : FractalLevel :=
  if lvl.level = target_level then
    (lvl.addNode node).2
  else
    let childIndex := computeChildIndexWith branching node.id lvl.level
    let childScale := scaleAtDepth branching (lvl.level + 1)
    let child := (AssocMap.get lvl.children childIndex).getD (FractalLevel.init (lvl.level + 1) childScale (lvl.path ++ [childIndex]))
    let child' := insertLevelAlongPath branching target_level node child
    { lvl with children := AssocMap.put lvl.children childIndex child' }

partial def deleteLevelAlongPath (branching max_depth : Nat) (node_id : ByteSlice) (lvl : FractalLevel) : Nat × FractalLevel :=
  let removedHere := lvl.removeNode node_id
  let removedCountHere := if removedHere.1 then 1 else 0
  let lvl1 := removedHere.2
  if lvl1.level >= max_depth then
    (removedCountHere, lvl1)
  else
    let childIndex := computeChildIndexWith branching node_id lvl1.level
    match AssocMap.get lvl1.children childIndex with
    | none => (removedCountHere, lvl1)
    | some child =>
        let childResult := deleteLevelAlongPath branching max_depth node_id child
        let children' :=
          if childResult.2.isEmpty then
            AssocMap.erase lvl1.children childIndex
          else
            AssocMap.put lvl1.children childIndex childResult.2
        (removedCountHere + childResult.1, { lvl1 with children := children' })

def init (max_depth branching_factor : Nat) (tree_id : TreeId := natToTreeId 0) : Except String FractalTree :=
  if branching_factor = 0 then
    .error "InvalidBranchingFactor"
  else
    .ok
      { root := FractalLevel.init 0 1 []
        max_depth := max_depth
        branching_factor := branching_factor
        total_nodes := 0
        tree_id := tree_id
        creation_time := 0
        last_modified := 0
        is_balanced := true
        depth_cache := none }

def computeChildIndex (t : FractalTree) (node_id : ByteSlice) (depth : Nat) : Nat :=
  computeChildIndexWith t.branching_factor node_id depth

def search (t : FractalTree) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Option FractalNodeData :=
  searchLevelAlongPath t.branching_factor t.max_depth node_id t.root

def getDepth (t : FractalTree) : Nat :=
  match t.depth_cache with
  | some d => d
  | none => t.root.getDepth

def computeOptimalDepth (t : FractalTree) : Nat :=
  if t.total_nodes = 0 then 0 else natLogCeil (Nat.max 2 t.branching_factor) t.total_nodes

def checkBalance (t : FractalTree) : FractalTree :=
  { t with is_balanced := t.getDepth ≤ t.computeOptimalDepth + 2 }

def estimateMemoryUsage (t : FractalTree) : Nat :=
  8 + t.root.estimateMemoryUsage

def insert (t : FractalTree) (node_id data : ByteSlice) (target_level : Nat) : Bool × FractalTree :=
  if target_level > t.max_depth then
    (false, t)
  else
    let deleteResult := deleteLevelAlongPath t.branching_factor t.max_depth node_id t.root
    let cleanedRoot := deleteResult.2.removeReferencesEverywhere node_id
    let node := FractalNodeData.init node_id data 1 (scaleAtDepth t.branching_factor target_level)
    let root' := insertLevelAlongPath t.branching_factor target_level node cleanedRoot
    let t' :=
      { t with
        root := root'
        total_nodes := root'.getTotalNodeCount
        last_modified := t.last_modified + 1
        depth_cache := none }
    (true, t'.checkBalance)

def delete (t : FractalTree) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Bool × FractalTree :=
  let deleteResult := deleteLevelAlongPath t.branching_factor t.max_depth node_id t.root
  if deleteResult.1 = 0 then
    (false, t)
  else
    let root' := deleteResult.2.removeReferencesEverywhere node_id
    let t' :=
      { t with
        root := root'
        total_nodes := root'.getTotalNodeCount
        last_modified := t.last_modified + 1
        depth_cache := none }
    (true, t'.checkBalance)

def balance (t : FractalTree) : FractalTree :=
  t.checkBalance

def computeFractalDimension (t : FractalTree) : Float :=
  let rec foldLevels (lvl : FractalLevel) : Float × Nat :=
    let local := lvl.computeLocalFractalDimension
    let childAcc := lvl.children.foldl (fun acc kv => let next := foldLevels kv.2; (acc.1 + next.1, acc.2 + next.2)) (0, 0)
    (local + childAcc.1, childAcc.2 + 1)
  let result := foldLevels t.root
  if result.2 = 0 then 0 else result.1 / Float.ofNat result.2

end FractalTree

structure PatternLocation where
  tree_id : TreeId
  level : Nat
  node_id : ByteSlice
  offset : Nat
  length : Nat
  confidence : Float
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def PatternLocation.init (tree_id : TreeId) (level : Nat) (node_id : ByteSlice) (offset length : Nat) (confidence : Float) : PatternLocation :=
  { tree_id := tree_id
    level := level
    node_id := node_id
    offset := offset
    length := length
    confidence := confidence }

def PatternLocation.clone (p : PatternLocation) : PatternLocation :=
  p

def PatternLocation.estimateMemoryUsage (p : PatternLocation) : Nat :=
  6 + p.tree_id.length + p.node_id.length

structure SimilarPatternResult where
  pattern : ByteSlice
  similarity : Float
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

structure SelfSimilarIndex where
  patterns : ByteMap (List PatternLocation)
  dimension_estimate : Float
  pattern_count : Nat
  total_locations : Nat
  min_pattern_length : Nat
  max_pattern_length : Nat
  similarity_threshold : Float
  creation_time : Int
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace SelfSimilarIndex

def init : SelfSimilarIndex :=
  { patterns := []
    dimension_estimate := 0
    pattern_count := 0
    total_locations := 0
    min_pattern_length := 1
    max_pattern_length := 256
    similarity_threshold := 0.8
    creation_time := 0 }

def addPattern (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) (location : PatternLocation) : Except String SelfSimilarIndex :=
  if pattern.length < i.min_pattern_length ∨ i.max_pattern_length < pattern.length then
    .error "PatternLengthOutOfRange"
  else
    let current := (AssocMap.get i.patterns pattern).getD []
    let isNew := current = []
    let patterns' := AssocMap.put i.patterns pattern (location :: current)
    .ok { i with
      patterns := patterns'
      pattern_count := if isNew then i.pattern_count + 1 else i.pattern_count
      total_locations := i.total_locations + 1 }

def findPattern (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) : List PatternLocation :=
  (AssocMap.get i.patterns pattern).getD []

def computeSimilarity (a b : ByteSlice) : Float :=
  let maxLen := Nat.max a.length b.length
  let minLen := Nat.min a.length b.length
  if maxLen = 0 then
    1
  else
    let zipped := List.zip a b
    let matches := zipped.foldl (fun acc kv => if kv.1 = kv.2 then acc + 1 else acc) 0
    let lengthRatio := Float.ofNat minLen / Float.ofNat maxLen
    let matchRatio := Float.ofNat matches / Float.ofNat maxLen
    (lengthRatio + matchRatio) / 2

def findSimilarPatterns (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) : List SimilarPatternResult :=
  i.patterns.foldl
    (fun acc kv =>
      let similarity := computeSimilarity pattern kv.1
      if i.similarity_threshold ≤ similarity then
        { pattern := kv.1, similarity := similarity } :: acc
      else
        acc)
    []

def removePattern (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) : Bool × SelfSimilarIndex :=
  let current := (AssocMap.get i.patterns pattern).getD []
  if current = [] then
    (false, i)
  else
    let patterns' := AssocMap.erase i.patterns pattern
    (true, { i with
      patterns := patterns'
      pattern_count := i.pattern_count - 1
      total_locations := i.total_locations - current.length })

def computeFractalDimension (i : SelfSimilarIndex) : Float :=
  if i.pattern_count = 0 then
    0
  else
    let lengths := i.patterns.map (fun kv => kv.1.length)
    let distinct := lengths.eraseDups.length
    Float.ofNat distinct / Float.ofNat i.pattern_count

def estimateMemoryUsage (i : SelfSimilarIndex) : Nat :=
  7 + i.patterns.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.1.length + kv.2.foldl (fun inner p => inner + p.estimateMemoryUsage) 0) 0

end SelfSimilarIndex

structure CoalescedHashMap (κ : Type) (α : Type) where
  map : AssocMap κ α
  capacity_hint : Nat
  max_load_factor : Float
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace CoalescedHashMap

variable {κ α : Type} [DecidableEq κ]

def init (capacity : Nat := 16) : CoalescedHashMap κ α :=
  { map := []
    capacity_hint := Nat.max 4 capacity
    max_load_factor := 0.86 }

def put (m : CoalescedHashMap κ α) (key : κ) (value : α) : CoalescedHashMap κ α :=
  { m with map := AssocMap.put m.map key value }

def get (m : CoalescedHashMap κ α) (key : κ) : Option α :=
  AssocMap.get m.map key

def contains (m : CoalescedHashMap κ α) (key : κ) : Bool :=
  AssocMap.contains m.map key

def remove (m : CoalescedHashMap κ α) (key : κ) : CoalescedHashMap κ α :=
  { m with map := AssocMap.erase m.map key }

def count (m : CoalescedHashMap κ α) : Nat :=
  m.map.length

def clear (m : CoalescedHashMap κ α) : CoalescedHashMap κ α :=
  { m with map := [] }

end CoalescedHashMap

def entryBytes (entries : ByteMap ByteSlice) : Nat :=
  entries.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.1.length + kv.2.length) 0

def touchOrder (order : List ByteSlice) (key : ByteSlice) : List ByteSlice :=
  key :: order.erase key

structure LRUCache where
  entries : ByteMap ByteSlice
  order : List ByteSlice
  head : Option ByteSlice
  tail : Option ByteSlice
  capacity : Nat
  current_size : Nat
  max_memory : Nat
  current_memory : Nat
  hits : Nat
  misses : Nat
  evictions : Nat
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace LRUCache

def init (capacity max_memory : Nat) : LRUCache :=
  { entries := []
    order := []
    head := none
    tail := none
    capacity := capacity
    current_size := 0
    max_memory := max_memory
    current_memory := 0
    hits := 0
    misses := 0
    evictions := 0 }

def getHitRatio (c : LRUCache) : Float :=
  let total := c.hits + c.misses
  if total = 0 then 0 else Float.ofNat c.hits / Float.ofNat total

def getSize (c : LRUCache) : Nat :=
  c.current_size

def getMemoryUsage (c : LRUCache) : Nat :=
  c.current_memory + c.current_size

def computeHead (order : List ByteSlice) : Option ByteSlice :=
  order.head?

def computeTail (order : List ByteSlice) : Option ByteSlice :=
  order.reverse.head?

def refreshStats (c : LRUCache) : LRUCache :=
  { c with
    current_size := c.entries.length
    current_memory := entryBytes c.entries
    head := computeHead c.order
    tail := computeTail c.order }

def get (c : LRUCache) (key : ByteSlice) : Option ByteSlice × LRUCache :=
  match AssocMap.get c.entries key with
  | none => (none, { c with misses := c.misses + 1 })
  | some value =>
      let order' := touchOrder c.order key
      (some value, { c with order := order', hits := c.hits + 1, head := computeHead order', tail := computeTail order' })

def remove (c : LRUCache) (key : ByteSlice) : Bool × LRUCache :=
  match AssocMap.get c.entries key with
  | none => (false, c)
  | some _ =>
      let entries' := AssocMap.erase c.entries key
      let order' := c.order.erase key
      (true, refreshStats { c with entries := entries', order := order' })

def evictOne (c : LRUCache) : LRUCache :=
  match computeTail c.order with
  | none => c
  | some key =>
      let removed := remove c key
      if removed.1 then { removed.2 with evictions := removed.2.evictions + 1 } else c

def clear (c : LRUCache) : LRUCache :=
  { c with entries := [], order := [], head := none, tail := none, current_size := 0, current_memory := 0 }

def put (c : LRUCache) (key value : ByteSlice) : Except String LRUCache :=
  if c.capacity = 0 then
    .error "CacheCapacityZero"
  else if key.length + value.length > c.max_memory then
    .error "EntryTooLarge"
  else
    let withoutKey := (remove c key).2
    let rec makeRoom (state : LRUCache) : LRUCache :=
      let wouldSize := state.entries.length + 1
      let wouldMemory := entryBytes state.entries + key.length + value.length
      if state.capacity < wouldSize ∨ state.max_memory < wouldMemory then
        match computeTail state.order with
        | none => state
        | some _ => makeRoom (evictOne state)
      else
        state
    let prepared := makeRoom withoutKey
    let wouldSize := prepared.entries.length + 1
    let wouldMemory := entryBytes prepared.entries + key.length + value.length
    if prepared.capacity < wouldSize ∨ prepared.max_memory < wouldMemory then
      .error "EntryTooLarge"
    else
      let entries' := AssocMap.put prepared.entries key value
      let order' := touchOrder prepared.order key
      .ok <| refreshStats { prepared with entries := entries', order := order' }

end LRUCache

def buildCacheKey (tree_id : TreeId) (node_id : ByteSlice) : ByteSlice :=
  tree_id ++ natToByteSlice8 node_id.length ++ natToByteSliceFixed 32 (byteHash node_id)

structure FNDSManager where
  fractal_trees : AssocMap TreeId FractalTree

  let totalDepth := m.fractal_trees.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.2.getDepth) 0
  let totalNodes := m.fractal_trees.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.2.total_nodes) 0
  let totalPatterns := m.indices.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.2.pattern_count) 0
  let memoryUsed :=

    m.indices.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.1.length + kv.2.estimateMemoryUsage) 0
  let stats1 := { m.statistics with
      total_trees := m.fractal_trees.length
      total_indices := m.indices.length
      cache_hits := m.cache.hits
      cache_misses := m.cache.misses
      memory_used := memoryUsed
      total_nodes_across_trees := totalNodes
      total_patterns_indexed := totalPatterns }
  let stats2 := stats1.updateCacheHitRatio
  let stats3 := stats2.updateAverageTreeDepth totalDepth m.fractal_trees.length
  { m with statistics := stats3 }

def createTree (m : FNDSManager) (max_depth branching_factor : Nat) : Except String (TreeId × FNDSManager) :=
  let treeId := natToTreeId m.next_tree_seed
  match FractalTree.init max_depth branching_factor treeId with
  | .error err => .error err
  | .ok tree =>
      let trees' := AssocMap.put m.fractal_trees treeId tree
      let m' := updateStatistics { m with fractal_trees := trees', next_tree_seed := m.next_tree_seed + 1 }
      .ok (treeId, m')

def removeTree (m : FNDSManager) (tree_id : TreeId) : Bool × FNDSManager :=
  if AssocMap.contains m.fractal_trees tree_id then
    let trees' := AssocMap.erase m.fractal_trees tree_id
    (true, updateStatistics { m with fractal_trees := trees', cache := m.cache.clear })
  else
    (false, m)

def createIndex (m : FNDSManager) (index_id : String) : Except String FNDSManager :=
  if AssocMap.contains m.indices index_id then
    .error "IndexAlreadyExists"
  else
    .ok <| updateStatistics { m with indices := AssocMap.put m.indices index_id SelfSimilarIndex.init }

def removeIndex (m : FNDSManager) (index_id : String) : Bool × FNDSManager :=
  if AssocMap.contains m.indices index_id then
    (true, updateStatistics { m with indices := AssocMap.erase m.indices index_id })
  else
    (false, m)

def cacheGet (m : FNDSManager) (key : ByteSlice) : Option ByteSlice × FNDSManager :=
  let result := m.cache.get key
  let m' := updateStatistics { m with cache := result.2 }
  (result.1, m')

def cachePut (m : FNDSManager) (key value : ByteSlice) : Except String FNDSManager :=
  match m.cache.put key value with
  | .error err => .error err
  | .ok cache' => .ok <| updateStatistics { m with cache := cache' }

def insertIntoTree (m : FNDSManager) (tree_id : TreeId) (node_id data : ByteSlice) (level : Nat) : Except String FNDSManager :=
  match AssocMap.get m.fractal_trees tree_id with
  | none => .error "TreeNotFound"
  | some tree =>
      let result := tree.insert node_id data level
      if result.1 then
        .ok <| updateStatistics { m with fractal_trees := AssocMap.put m.fractal_trees tree_id result.2, cache := m.cache.clear }
      else
        .error "InsertFailed"

def deleteFromTree (m : FNDSManager) (tree_id : TreeId) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Except String FNDSManager :=
  match AssocMap.get m.fractal_trees tree_id with
  | none => .error "TreeNotFound"
  | some tree =>
      let result := tree.delete node_id
      if result.1 then
        .ok <| updateStatistics { m with fractal_trees := AssocMap.put m.fractal_trees tree_id result.2, cache := m.cache.clear }
      else
        .error "NodeNotFound"

def searchInTree (m : FNDSManager) (tree_id : TreeId) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Option FractalNodeData × FNDSManager :=
  match AssocMap.get m.fractal_trees tree_id with
  | none => (none, m)
  | some tree =>
      let cacheKey := buildCacheKey tree_id node_id
      let cacheResult := cacheGet m cacheKey
      match tree.search node_id with
      | none =>
          let m' :=
            match cacheResult.1 with
            | some _ => updateStatistics { cacheResult.2 with cache := (cacheResult.2.cache.remove cacheKey).2 }
            | none => cacheResult.2
          (none, m')
      | some node =>
          match cacheResult.1 with
          | some cached =>
              if cached = node.data then
                (some node, cacheResult.2)
              else
                match cachePut { cacheResult.2 with cache := (cacheResult.2.cache.remove cacheKey).2 } cacheKey node.data with
                | .error _ => (some node, cacheResult.2)
                | .ok m' => (some node, m')
          | none =>
              match cachePut cacheResult.2 cacheKey node.data with
              | .error _ => (some node, cacheResult.2)
              | .ok m' => (some node, m')

def addPatternToIndex (m : FNDSManager) (index_id : String) (pattern : ByteSlice) (location : PatternLocation) : Except String FNDSManager :=
  match AssocMap.get m.indices index_id with
  | none => .error "IndexNotFound"
  | some index =>
      match index.addPattern pattern location with
      | .error err => .error err
      | .ok index' => .ok <| updateStatistics { m with indices := AssocMap.put m.indices index_id index' }

def findPatternInIndex (m : FNDSManager) (index_id : String) (pattern : ByteSlice) : List PatternLocation :=
  match AssocMap.get m.indices index_id with
  | none => []
  | some index => index.findPattern pattern

def computeGlobalFractalDimension (m : FNDSManager) : Float :=
  let treeDims := m.fractal_trees.map (fun kv => kv.2.computeFractalDimension)
  let indexDims := m.indices.map (fun kv => kv.2.computeFractalDimension)
  let allDims := treeDims ++ indexDims
  if allDims.isEmpty then 0 else allDims.foldl (· + ·) 0 / Float.ofNat allDims.length

end FNDSManager

end FNDS

namespace AssocMap

variable {κ α : Type} [DecidableEq κ]

def empty : AssocMap κ α := []

def size (m : AssocMap κ α) : Nat :=
  m.length

def get : AssocMap κ α → κ → Option α
  | [], _ => none
  | (k, v) :: xs, key =>

  | none => false

def erase : AssocMap κ α → κ → AssocMap κ α
  | [], _ => []
  | (k, v) :: xs, key =>

def natToByteSliceFixed : Nat → Nat → ByteSlice
  | 0, _ => []
  | n + 1, value => UInt8.ofNat (value % 256) :: natToByteSliceFixed n (value / 256)

def natToByteSlice8 (n : Nat) : ByteSlice :=
  natToByteSliceFixed 8 n

def natToTreeId (n : Nat) : TreeId :=
  natToByteSliceFixed 32 n

def zeroByteArray8 : ByteArray8 :=
  natToByteSliceFixed 8 0

def canonicalNaNByteArray8 : ByteArray8 :=
  [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 248, 127]

def byteHash : ByteSlice → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | b :: bs => b.toNat + 257 * byteHash bs

def stringByteHash (s : String) : Nat :=
  byteHash s.data.toList.map Char.toUInt8

def stableF64Bytes (x : Float) : ByteArray8 :=
  if x.isNaN then
    canonicalNaNByteArray8
  else if x = 0 then
    zeroByteArray8
  else
    natToByteSlice8 (hash x)

def take32 (bs : ByteSlice) : ByteSlice :=
  bs.take 32

def combineSignature (id data : ByteSlice) (weight scale : Float) : ByteSlice :=

structure FNDSStatistics where
  total_trees : Nat
  total_indices : Nat
  cache_hits : Nat
  cache_misses : Nat
  average_tree_depth : Float
  memory_used : Nat
  total_nodes_across_trees : Nat
  total_patterns_indexed : Nat

    total_nodes_across_trees := 0
    total_patterns_indexed := 0
    cache_hit_ratio := 0
    last_operation_time_ns := 0 }

def FNDSStatistics.updateCacheHitRatio (s : FNDSStatistics) : FNDSStatistics :=
  let total := s.cache_hits + s.cache_misses
  { s with cache_hit_ratio := if total = 0 then 0 else Float.ofNat s.cache_hits / Float.ofNat total }

  FNDSStatistics.updateCacheHitRatio { s with cache_hits := s.cache_hits + 1 }

def FNDSStatistics.recordCacheMiss (s : FNDSStatistics) : FNDSStatistics :=

def FNDSStatistics.updateAverageTreeDepth (s : FNDSStatistics) (totalDepth treeCount : Nat) : FNDSStatistics :=
  { s with average_tree_depth := if treeCount = 0 then 0 else Float.ofNat totalDepth / Float.ofNat treeCount }

structure FractalNodeData where
  id : ByteSlice

  weight : Float
  scale : Float
  fractal_signature : ByteSlice

deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def FractalNodeData.init (id data : ByteSlice) (weight scale : Float) : FractalNodeData :=
  { id := id
    data := data
    weight := weight
    scale := scale
    fractal_signature := combineSignature id data weight scale

def FractalNodeData.clone (n : FractalNodeData) : FractalNodeData :=

def FractalNodeData.setMetadata (n : FractalNodeData) (key : String) (value : ByteSlice) : FractalNodeData :=
  { n with metadata := AssocMap.put n.metadata key value }

def FractalNodeData.getMetadata (n : FractalNodeData) (key : String) : Option ByteSlice :=
  AssocMap.get n.metadata key

def FractalNodeData.computeHash (n : FractalNodeData) : Nat :=
  byteHash n.id + byteHash n.data + byteHash n.fractal_signature + hash n.weight + hash n.scale + n.children_count +
    (n.metadata.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + stringByteHash kv.1 + byteHash kv.2) 0)

def FractalNodeData.estimateMemoryUsage (n : FractalNodeData) : Nat :=
  6 + n.id.length + n.data.length + n.fractal_signature.length +
    (n.metadata.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.1.length + kv.2.length) 0)

inductive EdgeType where
  | hierarchical
  | sibling
  | cross_level
  | self_similar
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

structure FractalEdgeData where
  source_id : ByteSlice
  target_id : ByteSlice
  weight : Float
  scale_ratio : Float
  edge_type : EdgeType

deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def FractalEdgeData.init (source_id target_id : ByteSlice) (weight scale_ratio : Float) (edge_type : EdgeType) : FractalEdgeData :=

    target_id := target_id

def FractalEdgeData.clone (e : FractalEdgeData) : FractalEdgeData :=

def FractalEdgeData.estimateMemoryUsage (e : FractalEdgeData) : Nat :=

  path : TreePath

  let inserted := !AssocMap.contains lvl.nodes node.id

  match AssocMap.get lvl.nodes node_id with
  | none => (false, lvl)
  | some _ =>
      let nodes' := AssocMap.erase lvl.nodes node_id
      let outgoing := (AssocMap.get lvl.edges node_id).getD []
      let edges' := AssocMap.erase lvl.edges node_id
      (true, { lvl with
        nodes := nodes'
        edges := edges'
        node_count := lvl.node_count - 1

    | .cross_level => containsNodeInSubtree lvl edge.target_id
    | _ => AssocMap.contains lvl.nodes edge.target_id

  else
    let current := (AssocMap.get lvl.edges edge.source_id).getD []
    let deduped := current.filter (fun e => e.target_id ≠ edge.target_id ∨ e.edge_type ≠ edge.edge_type)

  let current := (AssocMap.get lvl.edges source_id).getD []
  let remaining := current.filter (fun e => e.target_id ≠ target_id)
  if remaining.length = current.length then

  else
    let edges' := if remaining.isEmpty then AssocMap.erase lvl.edges source_id else AssocMap.put lvl.edges source_id remaining

      | none => lvl.nodes
      | some source => AssocMap.put lvl.nodes source_id { source with children_count := remaining.length }

def estimateBoxCount (lvl : FractalLevel) (box_size : Nat) : Nat :=
  if box_size = 0 then
    0
  else
    let content := lvl.node_count + lvl.edge_count + lvl.children.length
    if content = 0 then 0 else (content + box_size - 1) / box_size

def computeLocalFractalDimension (lvl : FractalLevel) : Float :=
  let samples := [1, 2, 4, 8]
  let usable := samples.filter (fun box => lvl.estimateBoxCount box > 0)
  if usable.length < 2 then
    if lvl.node_count = 0 then 0 else 1
  else
    let boxAvg := usable.foldl (fun acc box => acc + Float.ofNat (lvl.estimateBoxCount box)) 0 / Float.ofNat usable.length

def isEmpty (lvl : FractalLevel) : Bool :=
  lvl.node_count = 0 ∧ lvl.edge_count = 0 ∧ lvl.children = []

end FractalLevel

structure FractalTree where
  root : FractalLevel
  max_depth : Nat
  branching_factor : Nat
  total_nodes : Nat
  tree_id : TreeId
  creation_time : Int
  last_modified : Int
  is_balanced : Bool

deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace FractalTree

private def scaleAtDepth (branching depth : Nat) : Float :=
  let base := Float.ofNat (Nat.max 1 branching)
  let rec loop : Nat → Float
    | 0 => 1
    | n + 1 => loop n / base
  loop depth

private def natLogCeilAux (base target current depth : Nat) : Nat :=
  if current >= target then depth else natLogCeilAux base target (current * base) (depth + 1)

private def natLogCeil (base target : Nat) : Nat :=
  if base ≤ 1 then 0 else natLogCeilAux base (Nat.max 1 target) 1 0

private def computeChildIndexWith (branching : Nat) (node_id : ByteSlice) (depth : Nat) : Nat :=

  match lvl.getNode node_id with

        none

        | none => none

    (lvl.addNode node).2
  else
    let childIndex := computeChildIndexWith branching node.id lvl.level
    let childScale := scaleAtDepth branching (lvl.level + 1)
    let child := (AssocMap.get lvl.children childIndex).getD (FractalLevel.init (lvl.level + 1) childScale (lvl.path ++ [childIndex]))
    let child' := insertLevelAlongPath branching target_level node child
    { lvl with children := AssocMap.put lvl.children childIndex child' }

partial def deleteLevelAlongPath (branching max_depth : Nat) (node_id : ByteSlice) (lvl : FractalLevel) : Nat × FractalLevel :=
  let removedHere := lvl.removeNode node_id
  let removedCountHere := if removedHere.1 then 1 else 0
  let lvl1 := removedHere.2
  if lvl1.level >= max_depth then
    (removedCountHere, lvl1)
  else
    let childIndex := computeChildIndexWith branching node_id lvl1.level
    match AssocMap.get lvl1.children childIndex with
    | none => (removedCountHere, lvl1)
    | some child =>
        let childResult := deleteLevelAlongPath branching max_depth node_id child
        let children' :=
          if childResult.2.isEmpty then
            AssocMap.erase lvl1.children childIndex
          else
            AssocMap.put lvl1.children childIndex childResult.2
        (removedCountHere + childResult.1, { lvl1 with children := children' })

def init (max_depth branching_factor : Nat) (tree_id : TreeId := natToTreeId 0) : Except String FractalTree :=
  if branching_factor = 0 then
    .error "InvalidBranchingFactor"
  else
    .ok
      { root := FractalLevel.init 0 1 []
        max_depth := max_depth
        branching_factor := branching_factor
        total_nodes := 0
        tree_id := tree_id
        creation_time := 0
        last_modified := 0
        is_balanced := true
        depth_cache := none }

def computeChildIndex (t : FractalTree) (node_id : ByteSlice) (depth : Nat) : Nat :=
  computeChildIndexWith t.branching_factor node_id depth

def search (t : FractalTree) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Option FractalNodeData :=
  searchLevelAlongPath t.branching_factor t.max_depth node_id t.root

def getDepth (t : FractalTree) : Nat :=
  match t.depth_cache with
  | some d => d
  | none => t.root.getDepth

def computeOptimalDepth (t : FractalTree) : Nat :=
  if t.total_nodes = 0 then 0 else natLogCeil (Nat.max 2 t.branching_factor) t.total_nodes

def checkBalance (t : FractalTree) : FractalTree :=
  { t with is_balanced := t.getDepth ≤ t.computeOptimalDepth + 2 }

def estimateMemoryUsage (t : FractalTree) : Nat :=
  8 + t.root.estimateMemoryUsage

def insert (t : FractalTree) (node_id data : ByteSlice) (target_level : Nat) : Bool × FractalTree :=
  if target_level > t.max_depth then
    (false, t)
  else
    let deleteResult := deleteLevelAlongPath t.branching_factor t.max_depth node_id t.root
    let cleanedRoot := deleteResult.2.removeReferencesEverywhere node_id
    let node := FractalNodeData.init node_id data 1 (scaleAtDepth t.branching_factor target_level)
    let root' := insertLevelAlongPath t.branching_factor target_level node cleanedRoot
    let t' :=
      { t with
        root := root'
        total_nodes := root'.getTotalNodeCount
        last_modified := t.last_modified + 1
        depth_cache := none }
    (true, t'.checkBalance)

def delete (t : FractalTree) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Bool × FractalTree :=
  let deleteResult := deleteLevelAlongPath t.branching_factor t.max_depth node_id t.root
  if deleteResult.1 = 0 then
    (false, t)
  else
    let root' := deleteResult.2.removeReferencesEverywhere node_id
    let t' :=
      { t with
        root := root'
        total_nodes := root'.getTotalNodeCount
        last_modified := t.last_modified + 1
        depth_cache := none }
    (true, t'.checkBalance)

def balance (t : FractalTree) : FractalTree :=
  t.checkBalance

def computeFractalDimension (t : FractalTree) : Float :=
  let rec foldLevels (lvl : FractalLevel) : Float × Nat :=
    let local := lvl.computeLocalFractalDimension
    let childAcc := lvl.children.foldl (fun acc kv => let next := foldLevels kv.2; (acc.1 + next.1, acc.2 + next.2)) (0, 0)
    (local + childAcc.1, childAcc.2 + 1)
  let result := foldLevels t.root
  if result.2 = 0 then 0 else result.1 / Float.ofNat result.2

end FractalTree

structure PatternLocation where
  tree_id : TreeId
  level : Nat
  node_id : ByteSlice
  offset : Nat
  length : Nat
  confidence : Float
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def PatternLocation.init (tree_id : TreeId) (level : Nat) (node_id : ByteSlice) (offset length : Nat) (confidence : Float) : PatternLocation :=
  { tree_id := tree_id
    level := level
    node_id := node_id
    offset := offset
    length := length
    confidence := confidence }

def PatternLocation.clone (p : PatternLocation) : PatternLocation :=
  p

def PatternLocation.estimateMemoryUsage (p : PatternLocation) : Nat :=
  6 + p.tree_id.length + p.node_id.length

structure SimilarPatternResult where
  pattern : ByteSlice
  similarity : Float
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

structure SelfSimilarIndex where
  patterns : ByteMap (List PatternLocation)
  dimension_estimate : Float
  pattern_count : Nat
  total_locations : Nat
  min_pattern_length : Nat
  max_pattern_length : Nat
  similarity_threshold : Float
  creation_time : Int
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace SelfSimilarIndex

def init : SelfSimilarIndex :=
  { patterns := []
    dimension_estimate := 0
    pattern_count := 0
    total_locations := 0
    min_pattern_length := 1
    max_pattern_length := 256
    similarity_threshold := 0.8
    creation_time := 0 }

def addPattern (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) (location : PatternLocation) : Except String SelfSimilarIndex :=
  if pattern.length < i.min_pattern_length ∨ i.max_pattern_length < pattern.length then
    .error "PatternLengthOutOfRange"
  else
    let current := (AssocMap.get i.patterns pattern).getD []
    let isNew := current = []
    let patterns' := AssocMap.put i.patterns pattern (location :: current)
    .ok { i with
      patterns := patterns'
      pattern_count := if isNew then i.pattern_count + 1 else i.pattern_count
      total_locations := i.total_locations + 1 }

def findPattern (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) : List PatternLocation :=
  (AssocMap.get i.patterns pattern).getD []

def computeSimilarity (a b : ByteSlice) : Float :=
  let maxLen := Nat.max a.length b.length
  let minLen := Nat.min a.length b.length
  if maxLen = 0 then
    1
  else
    let zipped := List.zip a b
    let matches := zipped.foldl (fun acc kv => if kv.1 = kv.2 then acc + 1 else acc) 0
    let lengthRatio := Float.ofNat minLen / Float.ofNat maxLen
    let matchRatio := Float.ofNat matches / Float.ofNat maxLen
    (lengthRatio + matchRatio) / 2

def findSimilarPatterns (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) : List SimilarPatternResult :=
  i.patterns.foldl
    (fun acc kv =>
      let similarity := computeSimilarity pattern kv.1
      if i.similarity_threshold ≤ similarity then
        { pattern := kv.1, similarity := similarity } :: acc
      else
        acc)
    []

def removePattern (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) : Bool × SelfSimilarIndex :=
  let current := (AssocMap.get i.patterns pattern).getD []
  if current = [] then
    (false, i)
  else
    let patterns' := AssocMap.erase i.patterns pattern
    (true, { i with
      patterns := patterns'
      pattern_count := i.pattern_count - 1
      total_locations := i.total_locations - current.length })

def computeFractalDimension (i : SelfSimilarIndex) : Float :=
  if i.pattern_count = 0 then
    0
  else
    let lengths := i.patterns.map (fun kv => kv.1.length)
    let distinct := lengths.eraseDups.length
    Float.ofNat distinct / Float.ofNat i.pattern_count

def estimateMemoryUsage (i : SelfSimilarIndex) : Nat :=
  7 + i.patterns.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.1.length + kv.2.foldl (fun inner p => inner + p.estimateMemoryUsage) 0) 0

end SelfSimilarIndex

structure CoalescedHashMap (κ : Type) (α : Type) where
  map : AssocMap κ α
  capacity_hint : Nat
  max_load_factor : Float
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace CoalescedHashMap

variable {κ α : Type} [DecidableEq κ]

def init (capacity : Nat := 16) : CoalescedHashMap κ α :=
  { map := []
    capacity_hint := Nat.max 4 capacity
    max_load_factor := 0.86 }

def put (m : CoalescedHashMap κ α) (key : κ) (value : α) : CoalescedHashMap κ α :=
  { m with map := AssocMap.put m.map key value }

def get (m : CoalescedHashMap κ α) (key : κ) : Option α :=
  AssocMap.get m.map key

def contains (m : CoalescedHashMap κ α) (key : κ) : Bool :=
  AssocMap.contains m.map key

def remove (m : CoalescedHashMap κ α) (key : κ) : CoalescedHashMap κ α :=
  { m with map := AssocMap.erase m.map key }

def count (m : CoalescedHashMap κ α) : Nat :=
  m.map.length

def clear (m : CoalescedHashMap κ α) : CoalescedHashMap κ α :=
  { m with map := [] }

end CoalescedHashMap

def entryBytes (entries : ByteMap ByteSlice) : Nat :=
  entries.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.1.length + kv.2.length) 0

def touchOrder (order : List ByteSlice) (key : ByteSlice) : List ByteSlice :=
  key :: order.erase key

structure LRUCache where
  entries : ByteMap ByteSlice
  order : List ByteSlice
  head : Option ByteSlice
  tail : Option ByteSlice
  capacity : Nat
  current_size : Nat
  max_memory : Nat
  current_memory : Nat
  hits : Nat
  misses : Nat
  evictions : Nat
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace LRUCache

def init (capacity max_memory : Nat) : LRUCache :=
  { entries := []
    order := []
    head := none
    tail := none
    capacity := capacity
    current_size := 0
    max_memory := max_memory
    current_memory := 0
    hits := 0
    misses := 0
    evictions := 0 }

def getHitRatio (c : LRUCache) : Float :=
  let total := c.hits + c.misses
  if total = 0 then 0 else Float.ofNat c.hits / Float.ofNat total

def getSize (c : LRUCache) : Nat :=
  c.current_size

def getMemoryUsage (c : LRUCache) : Nat :=
  c.current_memory + c.current_size

def computeHead (order : List ByteSlice) : Option ByteSlice :=
  order.head?

def computeTail (order : List ByteSlice) : Option ByteSlice :=
  order.reverse.head?

def refreshStats (c : LRUCache) : LRUCache :=
  { c with
    current_size := c.entries.length
    current_memory := entryBytes c.entries
    head := computeHead c.order
    tail := computeTail c.order }

def get (c : LRUCache) (key : ByteSlice) : Option ByteSlice × LRUCache :=
  match AssocMap.get c.entries key with
  | none => (none, { c with misses := c.misses + 1 })
  | some value =>
      let order' := touchOrder c.order key
      (some value, { c with order := order', hits := c.hits + 1, head := computeHead order', tail := computeTail order' })

def remove (c : LRUCache) (key : ByteSlice) : Bool × LRUCache :=
  match AssocMap.get c.entries key with
  | none => (false, c)
  | some _ =>
      let entries' := AssocMap.erase c.entries key
      let order' := c.order.erase key
      (true, refreshStats { c with entries := entries', order := order' })

def evictOne (c : LRUCache) : LRUCache :=
  match computeTail c.order with
  | none => c
  | some key =>
      let removed := remove c key
      if removed.1 then { removed.2 with evictions := removed.2.evictions + 1 } else c

def clear (c : LRUCache) : LRUCache :=
  { c with entries := [], order := [], head := none, tail := none, current_size := 0, current_memory := 0 }

def put (c : LRUCache) (key value : ByteSlice) : Except String LRUCache :=
  if c.capacity = 0 then
    .error "CacheCapacityZero"
  else if key.length + value.length > c.max_memory then
    .error "EntryTooLarge"
  else
    let withoutKey := (remove c key).2
    let rec makeRoom (state : LRUCache) : LRUCache :=
      let wouldSize := state.entries.length + 1
      let wouldMemory := entryBytes state.entries + key.length + value.length
      if state.capacity < wouldSize ∨ state.max_memory < wouldMemory then
        match computeTail state.order with
        | none => state
        | some _ => makeRoom (evictOne state)
      else
        state
    let prepared := makeRoom withoutKey
    let wouldSize := prepared.entries.length + 1
    let wouldMemory := entryBytes prepared.entries + key.length + value.length
    if prepared.capacity < wouldSize ∨ prepared.max_memory < wouldMemory then
      .error "EntryTooLarge"
    else
      let entries' := AssocMap.put prepared.entries key value
      let order' := touchOrder prepared.order key
      .ok <| refreshStats { prepared with entries := entries', order := order' }

end LRUCache

def buildCacheKey (tree_id : TreeId) (node_id : ByteSlice) : ByteSlice :=
  tree_id ++ natToByteSlice8 node_id.length ++ natToByteSliceFixed 32 (byteHash node_id)

structure FNDSManager where
  fractal_trees : AssocMap TreeId FractalTree
  indices : StringHashMap SelfSimilarIndex
  cache : LRUCache
  statistics : FNDSStatistics
  creation_time : Int
  next_tree_seed : Nat
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace FNDSManager

def init : FNDSManager :=
  { fractal_trees := []
    indices := []
    cache := LRUCache.init 1000 (10 * 1024 * 1024)
    statistics := FNDSStatistics.init
    creation_time := 0
    next_tree_seed := 1 }

def initWithCache (cache_capacity cache_memory : Nat) : FNDSManager :=
  { init with cache := LRUCache.init cache_capacity cache_memory }

def getTree (m : FNDSManager) (tree_id : TreeId) : Option FractalTree :=
  AssocMap.get m.fractal_trees tree_id

def getIndex (m : FNDSManager) (index_id : String) : Option SelfSimilarIndex :=
  AssocMap.get m.indices index_id

def updateStatistics (m : FNDSManager) : FNDSManager :=
  let totalDepth := m.fractal_trees.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.2.getDepth) 0
  let totalNodes := m.fractal_trees.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.2.total_nodes) 0
  let totalPatterns := m.indices.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.2.pattern_count) 0
  let memoryUsed :=
    m.cache.getMemoryUsage +
    m.fractal_trees.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.1.length + kv.2.estimateMemoryUsage) 0 +
    m.indices.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.1.length + kv.2.estimateMemoryUsage) 0
  let stats1 := { m.statistics with
      total_trees := m.fractal_trees.length
      total_indices := m.indices.length
      cache_hits := m.cache.hits
      cache_misses := m.cache.misses
      memory_used := memoryUsed
      total_nodes_across_trees := totalNodes
      total_patterns_indexed := totalPatterns }
  let stats2 := stats1.updateCacheHitRatio
  let stats3 := stats2.updateAverageTreeDepth totalDepth m.fractal_trees.length
  { m with statistics := stats3 }

def createTree (m : FNDSManager) (max_depth branching_factor : Nat) : Except String (TreeId × FNDSManager) :=
  let treeId := natToTreeId m.next_tree_seed
  match FractalTree.init max_depth branching_factor treeId with
  | .error err => .error err
  | .ok tree =>
      let trees' := AssocMap.put m.fractal_trees treeId tree
      let m' := updateStatistics { m with fractal_trees := trees', next_tree_seed := m.next_tree_seed + 1 }
      .ok (treeId, m')

def removeTree (m : FNDSManager) (tree_id : TreeId) : Bool × FNDSManager :=
  if AssocMap.contains m.fractal_trees tree_id then
    let trees' := AssocMap.erase m.fractal_trees tree_id
    (true, updateStatistics { m with fractal_trees := trees', cache := m.cache.clear })
  else
    (false, m)

def createIndex (m : FNDSManager) (index_id : String) : Except String FNDSManager :=
  if AssocMap.contains m.indices index_id then
    .error "IndexAlreadyExists"
  else
    .ok <| updateStatistics { m with indices := AssocMap.put m.indices index_id SelfSimilarIndex.init }

def removeIndex (m : FNDSManager) (index_id : String) : Bool × FNDSManager :=
  if AssocMap.contains m.indices index_id then
    (true, updateStatistics { m with indices := AssocMap.erase m.indices index_id })
  else
    (false, m)

def cacheGet (m : FNDSManager) (key : ByteSlice) : Option ByteSlice × FNDSManager :=
  let result := m.cache.get key
  let m' := updateStatistics { m with cache := result.2 }
  (result.1, m')

def cachePut (m : FNDSManager) (key value : ByteSlice) : Except String FNDSManager :=
  match m.cache.put key value with
  | .error err => .error err
  | .ok cache' => .ok <| updateStatistics { m with cache := cache' }

def insertIntoTree (m : FNDSManager) (tree_id : TreeId) (node_id data : ByteSlice) (level : Nat) : Except String FNDSManager :=
  match AssocMap.get m.fractal_trees tree_id with
  | none => .error "TreeNotFound"
  | some tree =>
      let result := tree.insert node_id data level
      if result.1 then
        .ok <| updateStatistics { m with fractal_trees := AssocMap.put m.fractal_trees tree_id result.2, cache := m.cache.clear }
      else
        .error "InsertFailed"

def deleteFromTree (m : FNDSManager) (tree_id : TreeId) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Except String FNDSManager :=
  match AssocMap.get m.fractal_trees tree_id with
  | none => .error "TreeNotFound"
  | some tree =>
      let result := tree.delete node_id
      if result.1 then
        .ok <| updateStatistics { m with fractal_trees := AssocMap.put m.fractal_trees tree_id result.2, cache := m.cache.clear }
      else
        .error "NodeNotFound"

def searchInTree (m : FNDSManager) (tree_id : TreeId) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Option FractalNodeData × FNDSManager :=
  match AssocMap.get m.fractal_trees tree_id with
  | none => (none, m)
  | some tree =>
      let cacheKey := buildCacheKey tree_id node_id
      let cacheResult := cacheGet m cacheKey
      match tree.search node_id with
      | none =>
          let m' :=
            match cacheResult.1 with
            | some _ => updateStatistics { cacheResult.2 with cache := (cacheResult.2.cache.remove cacheKey).2 }
            | none => cacheResult.2
          (none, m')
      | some node =>
          match cacheResult.1 with
          | some cached =>
              if cached = node.data then
                (some node, cacheResult.2)
              else
                match cachePut { cacheResult.2 with cache := (cacheResult.2.cache.remove cacheKey).2 } cacheKey node.data with
                | .error _ => (some node, cacheResult.2)
                | .ok m' => (some node, m')
          | none =>
              match cachePut cacheResult.2 cacheKey node.data with
              | .error _ => (some node, cacheResult.2)
              | .ok m' => (some node, m')

def addPatternToIndex (m : FNDSManager) (index_id : String) (pattern : ByteSlice) (location : PatternLocation) : Except String FNDSManager :=
  match AssocMap.get m.indices index_id with
  | none => .error "IndexNotFound"
  | some index =>
      match index.addPattern pattern location with
      | .error err => .error err
      | .ok index' => .ok <| updateStatistics { m with indices := AssocMap.put m.indices index_id index' }

def findPatternInIndex (m : FNDSManager) (index_id : String) (pattern : ByteSlice) : List PatternLocation :=
  match AssocMap.get m.indices index_id with
  | none => []
  | some index => index.findPattern pattern

def computeGlobalFractalDimension (m : FNDSManager) : Float :=
  let treeDims := m.fractal_trees.map (fun kv => kv.2.computeFractalDimension)
  let indexDims := m.indices.map (fun kv => kv.2.computeFractalDimension)
  let allDims := treeDims ++ indexDims
  if allDims.isEmpty then 0 else allDims.foldl (· + ·) 0 / Float.ofNat allDims.length

end FNDSManager

end FNDS

import Mathlib

namespace FNDS

abbrev ByteSlice := List UInt8
abbrev TreeId := Nat
abbrev CacheKey := TreeId × ByteSlice
abbrev AssocMap (κ : Type) (α : Type) := List (κ × α)
abbrev ByteMap (α : Type) := AssocMap ByteSlice α
abbrev TreeMap (α : Type) := AssocMap TreeId α
abbrev StringMap (α : Type) := AssocMap String α

namespace AssocMap

variable {κ α : Type} [DecidableEq κ]

def empty : AssocMap κ α := []

def size (m : AssocMap κ α) : Nat :=
  m.length

def get : AssocMap κ α → κ → Option α
  | [], _ => none
  | (k, v) :: xs, key => if k = key then some v else get xs key

def contains (m : AssocMap κ α) (key : κ) : Bool :=
  match get m key with
  | some _ => true
  | none => false

def erase : AssocMap κ α → κ → AssocMap κ α
  | [], _ => []
  | (k, v) :: xs, key => if k = key then erase xs key else (k, v) :: erase xs key

def put (m : AssocMap κ α) (key : κ) (value : α) : AssocMap κ α :=
  (key, value) :: erase m key

@[simp] theorem get_empty (key : κ) : get ([] : AssocMap κ α) key = none := rfl

@[simp] theorem get_erase_eq (m : AssocMap κ α) (key : κ) : get (erase m key) key = none := by
  induction m with
  | nil =>
      simp [erase, get]
  | cons hd tl ih =>
      rcases hd with ⟨k, v⟩
      by_cases h : k = key
      · simp [erase, get, h, ih]
      · simp [erase, get, h, ih]

theorem get_erase_ne (m : AssocMap κ α) (key key' : κ) (h : key' ≠ key) : get (erase m key) key' = get m key' := by
  induction m with
  | nil =>
      simp [erase, get]
  | cons hd tl ih =>
      rcases hd with ⟨k, v⟩
      by_cases hk : k = key
      · subst hk
        simp [erase, get, h, ih]
      · by_cases hk' : k = key'
        · subst hk'
          simp [erase, get, hk, ih]
        · simp [erase, get, hk, hk', ih]

@[simp] theorem get_put_eq (m : AssocMap κ α) (key : κ) (value : α) : get (put m key value) key = some value := by
  simp [put, get]

theorem get_put_ne (m : AssocMap κ α) (key key' : κ) (value : α) (h : key' ≠ key) :
    get (put m key value) key' = get m key' := by
  simp [put, get, h, get_erase_ne (m := m) (key := key) (key' := key') h]

end AssocMap

namespace FractalTree

private def scaleOfLevelAux (branching : Nat) : Nat → Rat
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => scaleOfLevelAux branching n / Rat.ofInt (Int.ofNat (Nat.max 1 branching))

def scaleOfLevel (t : FractalTree) (level : Nat) : Rat :=
  scaleOfLevelAux t.branching_factor level

def init (max_depth branching_factor : Nat) : Except String FractalTree :=
  if branching_factor = 0 then
    .error "InvalidBranchingFactor"
  else
    .ok
      { max_depth := max_depth
        branching_factor := branching_factor
        nodes := []
        edges := []
        creation_time := 0
        last_modified := 0
        is_balanced := true }

def totalNodes (t : FractalTree) : Nat :=
  AssocMap.size t.nodes

def searchEntry (t : FractalTree) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Option StoredNode :=
  AssocMap.get t.nodes node_id

def search (t : FractalTree) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Option FractalNodeData :=
  match searchEntry t node_id with
  | some entry => some entry.node
  | none => none

def levelOf (t : FractalTree) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Option Nat :=
  match searchEntry t node_id with
  | some entry => some entry.level
  | none => none

def outgoing (t : FractalTree) (source_id : ByteSlice) : List FractalEdgeData :=
  (AssocMap.get t.edges source_id).getD []

def sanitizeEdges (node_id : ByteSlice) (edges : ByteMap (List FractalEdgeData)) : ByteMap (List FractalEdgeData) :=
  edges.foldr
    (fun kv acc =>
      let filtered := kv.2.filter (fun e => e.source_id ≠ node_id ∧ e.target_id ≠ node_id)
      if filtered = [] then
        acc
      else
        AssocMap.put acc kv.1 filtered)
    []

def insertVerified (t : FractalTree) (node_id data : ByteSlice) (level : Nat) (_h : level ≤ t.max_depth) : FractalTree :=
  let node := FractalNodeData.init node_id data 1 (scaleOfLevel t level)
  let entry : StoredNode := { level := level, node := node }
  { t with
    nodes := AssocMap.put t.nodes node_id entry
    edges := sanitizeEdges node_id t.edges
    last_modified := t.last_modified + 1 }

def insert (t : FractalTree) (node_id data : ByteSlice) (level : Nat) : Except String FractalTree :=
  if h : level ≤ t.max_depth then
    .ok (insertVerified t node_id data level h)
  else
    .error "LevelOutOfRange"

def deleteVerified (t : FractalTree) (node_id : ByteSlice) : FractalTree :=
  { t with
    nodes := AssocMap.erase t.nodes node_id
    edges := sanitizeEdges node_id t.edges
    last_modified := t.last_modified + 1 }

def delete (t : FractalTree) (node_id : ByteSlice) : FractalTree :=
  deleteVerified t node_id

def addEdgeVerified (t : FractalTree) (edge : FractalEdgeData) : FractalTree :=
  let current := (AssocMap.get t.edges edge.source_id).getD []
  let deduped := current.filter (fun e => e.target_id ≠ edge.target_id)
  { t with
    edges := AssocMap.put t.edges edge.source_id (edge :: deduped)
    last_modified := t.last_modified + 1 }

def addEdge (t : FractalTree) (edge : FractalEdgeData) : Except String FractalTree :=
  match search t edge.source_id, search t edge.target_id with
  | some _, some _ => .ok (addEdgeVerified t edge)
  | _, _ => .error "NodeNotFound"

def removeEdgeVerified (t : FractalTree) (source_id target_id : ByteSlice) : FractalTree :=
  let current := (AssocMap.get t.edges source_id).getD []
  let remaining := current.filter (fun e => e.target_id ≠ target_id)
  let edges' := if remaining = [] then AssocMap.erase t.edges source_id else AssocMap.put t.edges source_id remaining
  { t with edges := edges', last_modified := t.last_modified + 1 }

def removeEdge (t : FractalTree) (source_id target_id : ByteSlice) : FractalTree :=
  removeEdgeVerified t source_id target_id

def levelView (t : FractalTree) (level : Nat) : FractalLevel :=
  let nodes :=
    t.nodes.foldr
      (fun kv acc =>
        if kv.2.level = level then
          AssocMap.put acc kv.1 kv.2.node
        else
          acc)
      []
  let edges :=
    t.edges.foldr
      (fun kv acc =>
        match levelOf t kv.1 with
        | some srcLevel =>
            if srcLevel = level then
              AssocMap.put acc kv.1 kv.2
            else
              acc
        | none => acc)
      []
  { level := level
    scale := scaleOfLevel t level
    nodes := nodes
    edges := edges }

def computeFractalDimension (t : FractalTree) : Rat :=
  if totalNodes t = 0 then
    0
  else
    Rat.ofInt (Int.ofNat (t.edges.length + totalNodes t)) / Rat.ofInt (Int.ofNat (Nat.max 1 (t.max_depth + 1)))

@[simp] theorem search_insertVerified_eq (t : FractalTree) (node_id data : ByteSlice) (level : Nat) (h : level ≤ t.max_depth) :
    search (insertVerified t node_id data level h) node_id = some (FractalNodeData.init node_id data 1 (scaleOfLevel t level)) := by
  simp [search, searchEntry, insertVerified]

theorem search_insertVerified_ne (t : FractalTree) (node_id other_id data : ByteSlice) (level : Nat) (h : level ≤ t.max_depth) (hne : other_id ≠ node_id) :
    search (insertVerified t node_id data level h) other_id = search t other_id := by
  simp [search, searchEntry, insertVerified, AssocMap.get_put_ne, hne]

@[simp] theorem levelOf_insertVerified_eq (t : FractalTree) (node_id data : ByteSlice) (level : Nat) (h : level ≤ t.max_depth) :
    levelOf (insertVerified t node_id data level h) node_id = some level := by
  simp [levelOf, searchEntry, insertVerified]

@[simp] theorem search_deleteVerified_eq_none (t : FractalTree) (node_id : ByteSlice) :
    search (deleteVerified t node_id) node_id = none := by
  simp [search, searchEntry, deleteVerified]

theorem search_deleteVerified_ne (t : FractalTree) (node_id other_id : ByteSlice) (hne : other_id ≠ node_id) :
    search (deleteVerified t node_id) other_id = search t other_id := by
  simp [search, searchEntry, deleteVerified, AssocMap.get_erase_ne, hne]

end FractalTree

  patterns : ByteMap (List PatternLocation)
  min_pattern_length : Nat
  max_pattern_length : Nat
  similarity_threshold : Rat
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace SelfSimilarIndex

def init : SelfSimilarIndex :=
  { patterns := []
    min_pattern_length := 1
    max_pattern_length := 256
    similarity_threshold := 4 / 5 }

def patternCount (i : SelfSimilarIndex) : Nat :=
  i.patterns.length

def totalLocations (i : SelfSimilarIndex) : Nat :=
  i.patterns.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.2.length) 0

def findPattern (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) : List PatternLocation :=
  (AssocMap.get i.patterns pattern).getD []

def addPatternVerified (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) (location : PatternLocation) : SelfSimilarIndex :=
  let current := (AssocMap.get i.patterns pattern).getD []
  { i with patterns := AssocMap.put i.patterns pattern (location :: current) }

def addPattern (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) (location : PatternLocation) : Except String SelfSimilarIndex :=
  if pattern.length < i.min_pattern_length then
    .error "PatternTooShort"
  else if i.max_pattern_length < pattern.length then
    .error "PatternTooLong"
  else
    .ok (addPatternVerified i pattern location)

def removePatternVerified (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) : SelfSimilarIndex :=
  { i with patterns := AssocMap.erase i.patterns pattern }

def removePattern (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) : SelfSimilarIndex :=
  removePatternVerified i pattern

def computeSimilarity (a b : ByteSlice) : Rat :=
  let maxLen := Nat.max a.length b.length
  if maxLen = 0 then
    1
  else
    let matches := (List.zip a b).foldl (fun acc kv => if kv.1 = kv.2 then acc + 1 else acc) 0
    Rat.ofInt (Int.ofNat matches) / Rat.ofInt (Int.ofNat maxLen)

def findSimilarPatterns (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) : List SimilarPatternResult :=
  i.patterns.foldr
    (fun kv acc =>
      let sim := computeSimilarity pattern kv.1
      if i.similarity_threshold ≤ sim then
        { pattern := kv.1, similarity := sim } :: acc
      else
        acc)
    []

@[simp] theorem findPattern_addPatternVerified_eq (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) (location : PatternLocation) :
    findPattern (addPatternVerified i pattern location) pattern = location :: findPattern i pattern := by
  simp [findPattern, addPatternVerified]

@[simp] theorem findPattern_removePatternVerified_eq (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern : ByteSlice) :
    findPattern (removePatternVerified i pattern) pattern = [] := by
  simp [findPattern, removePatternVerified]

theorem findPattern_addPatternVerified_ne (i : SelfSimilarIndex) (pattern other : ByteSlice) (location : PatternLocation) (h : other ≠ pattern) :
    findPattern (addPatternVerified i pattern location) other = findPattern i other := by
  simp [findPattern, addPatternVerified, AssocMap.get_put_ne, h]

end SelfSimilarIndex

structure LRUCache (κ : Type) where
  entries : AssocMap κ ByteSlice
  order : List κ
  capacity : Nat
  max_memory : Nat
  hits : Nat
  misses : Nat
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace LRUCache

variable {κ : Type} [DecidableEq κ]

def init (capacity max_memory : Nat) : LRUCache κ :=
  { entries := []
    order := []
    capacity := capacity
    max_memory := max_memory
    hits := 0
    misses := 0 }

def memoryUsage (c : LRUCache κ) : Nat :=
  c.entries.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.2.length) 0

def currentSize (c : LRUCache κ) : Nat :=
  c.entries.length

def hitRatio (c : LRUCache κ) : Rat :=
  let total := c.hits + c.misses
  if total = 0 then
    0
  else
    Rat.ofInt (Int.ofNat c.hits) / Rat.ofInt (Int.ofNat total)

def touch (order : List κ) (key : κ) : List κ :=
  key :: List.erase order key

def get (c : LRUCache κ) (key : κ) : Option ByteSlice × LRUCache κ :=
  match AssocMap.get c.entries key with
  | some value => (some value, { c with order := touch c.order key, hits := c.hits + 1 })
  | none => (none, { c with misses := c.misses + 1 })

def remove (c : LRUCache κ) (key : κ) : LRUCache κ :=
  { c with entries := AssocMap.erase c.entries key, order := List.erase c.order key }

def evictKey? (c : LRUCache κ) : Option κ :=
  c.order.reverse.head?

def evictOne (c : LRUCache κ) : LRUCache κ :=
  match evictKey? c with
  | some key => remove c key
  | none => c

def makeRoom (needed : Nat) : Nat → LRUCache κ → LRUCache κ
  | 0, c => c
  | n + 1, c =>
      if currentSize c < c.capacity ∧ memoryUsage c + needed ≤ c.max_memory then
        c
      else
        makeRoom needed n (evictOne c)

def putVerified (c : LRUCache κ) (key : κ) (value : ByteSlice) : LRUCache κ :=
  let base := remove c key
  let prepared := makeRoom value.length (currentSize base + 1) base
  { prepared with entries := AssocMap.put prepared.entries key value, order := touch prepared.order key }

def put (c : LRUCache κ) (key : κ) (value : ByteSlice) : Except String (LRUCache κ) :=
  if c.capacity = 0 then
    .error "ZeroCapacity"
  else if value.length > c.max_memory then
    .error "EntryTooLarge"
  else
    .ok (putVerified c key value)

@[simp] theorem get_putVerified_eq (c : LRUCache κ) (key : κ) (value : ByteSlice) :
    (get (putVerified c key value) key).1 = some value := by
  simp [get, putVerified]

end LRUCache

structure FNDSManager where
  fractal_trees : TreeMap FractalTree
  indices : StringMap SelfSimilarIndex
  cache : LRUCache CacheKey
  statistics : FNDSStatistics
  next_tree_id : TreeId
deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace FNDSManager

def init : FNDSManager :=
  { fractal_trees := []
    indices := []
    cache := LRUCache.init 1024 1048576
    statistics := FNDSStatistics.init
    next_tree_id := 0 }

def updateStatistics (m : FNDSManager) : FNDSManager :=
  let treeCount := m.fractal_trees.length
  let indexCount := m.indices.length
  let nodeCount := m.fractal_trees.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.2.totalNodes) 0
  let patternCount := m.indices.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.2.patternCount) 0
  let depthSum := m.fractal_trees.foldl (fun acc kv => acc + kv.2.max_depth) 0
  let stats0 :=
    { m.statistics with
      total_trees := treeCount
      total_indices := indexCount
      cache_hits := m.cache.hits
      cache_misses := m.cache.misses
      memory_used := m.cache.memoryUsage + nodeCount + patternCount
      total_nodes_across_trees := nodeCount
      total_patterns_indexed := patternCount }
  let stats1 := stats0.updateCacheHitRatio
  let stats2 := stats1.updateAverageTreeDepth depthSum treeCount
  { m with statistics := stats2 }

def createTree (m : FNDSManager) (max_depth branching_factor : Nat) : Except String (TreeId × FNDSManager) :=
  match FractalTree.init max_depth branching_factor with
  | .error err => .error err
  | .ok tree =>
      let tree_id := m.next_tree_id
      let trees' := AssocMap.put m.fractal_trees tree_id tree
      .ok (tree_id, updateStatistics { m with fractal_trees := trees', next_tree_id := tree_id + 1 })

def getTree (m : FNDSManager) (tree_id : TreeId) : Option FractalTree :=
  AssocMap.get m.fractal_trees tree_id

def createIndex (m : FNDSManager) (index_id : String) : Except String FNDSManager :=
  match AssocMap.get m.indices index_id with
  | some _ => .error "IndexAlreadyExists"
  | none => .ok (updateStatistics { m with indices := AssocMap.put m.indices index_id SelfSimilarIndex.init })

def insertIntoTree (m : FNDSManager) (tree_id : TreeId) (node_id data : ByteSlice) (level : Nat) : Except String FNDSManager :=
  match getTree m tree_id with
  | none => .error "TreeNotFound"
  | some tree =>
      match tree.insert node_id data level with
      | .error err => .error err
      | .ok tree' =>
          .ok <| updateStatistics
            { m with
              fractal_trees := AssocMap.put m.fractal_trees tree_id tree'
              cache := LRUCache.init m.cache.capacity m.cache.max_memory }

def deleteFromTree (m : FNDSManager) (tree_id : TreeId) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Except String FNDSManager :=
  match getTree m tree_id with
  | none => .error "TreeNotFound"
  | some tree =>
      let tree' := tree.delete node_id
      .ok <| updateStatistics
        { m with
          fractal_trees := AssocMap.put m.fractal_trees tree_id tree'
          cache := LRUCache.init m.cache.capacity m.cache.max_memory }

def searchInTree (m : FNDSManager) (tree_id : TreeId) (node_id : ByteSlice) : Option FractalNodeData × FNDSManager :=
  match getTree m tree_id with
  | none => (none, m)
  | some tree =>
      let key : CacheKey := (tree_id, node_id)
      let cacheResult := m.cache.get key
      match tree.search node_id with
      | some node =>
          let cache' :=
            match LRUCache.put cacheResult.2 key node.data with
            | .ok c => c
            | .error _ => cacheResult.2
          (some node, updateStatistics { m with cache := cache' })
      | none =>
          (none, updateStatistics { m with cache := cacheResult.2 })

def addPatternToIndex (m : FNDSManager) (index_id : String) (pattern : ByteSlice) (location : PatternLocation) : Except String FNDSManager :=
  match AssocMap.get m.indices index_id with
  | none => .error "IndexNotFound"
  | some index =>
      match index.addPattern pattern location with
      | .error err => .error err
      | .ok index' => .ok <| updateStatistics { m with indices := AssocMap.put m.indices index_id index' }

def findPatternInIndex (m : FNDSManager) (index_id : String) (pattern : ByteSlice) : List PatternLocation :=
  match AssocMap.get m.indices index_id with
  | some index => index.findPattern pattern
  | none => []

def computeGlobalFractalDimension (m : FNDSManager) : Rat :=
  let treeDims := m.fractal_trees.foldl (fun acc kv => kv.2.computeFractalDimension :: acc) []
  let indexDims := m.indices.foldl (fun acc kv => Rat.ofInt (Int.ofNat kv.2.patternCount) :: acc) []
  let dims := treeDims ++ indexDims
  if dims = [] then
    0
  else
    dims.foldl (· + ·) 0 / Rat.ofInt (Int.ofNat dims.length)

end FNDSManager

end FNDS

abbrev ByteSlice := List UInt8
abbrev TreeId := Nat
abbrev CacheKey := TreeId × ByteSlice
abbrev AssocMap (κ : Type) (α : Type) := List (κ × α)
abbrev ByteMap (α : Type) := AssocMap ByteSlice α
abbrev TreeMap (α : Type) := AssocMap TreeId α
abbrev StringMap (α : Type) := AssocMap String α

namespace AssocMap

variable {κ α : Type} [DecidableEq κ]

def empty : AssocMap κ α := []

def size (m : AssocMap κ α) : Nat :=
  m.length

def get : AssocMap κ α → κ → Option α
  | [], _ => none
  | (k, v) :: xs, key => if k = key then some v else get xs key

def contains (m : AssocMap κ α) (key : κ) : Bool :=
  match get m key with
  | some _ => true
  | none => false

def erase : AssocMap κ α → κ → AssocMap κ α
  | [], _ => []
  | (k, v) :: xs, key => if k = key then erase xs key else (k, v) :: erase xs key

def put (m : AssocMap κ α) (key : κ) (value : α) : AssocMap κ α :=
  (key, value) :: erase m key

@[simp] theorem get_empty (key : κ) : get ([] : AssocMap κ α) key = none := rfl

@[simp] theorem get_erase_eq (m : AssocMap κ α) (key : κ) : get (erase m key) key = none := by
  induction m with
  | nil =>
      simp [erase, get]
  | cons hd tl ih =>
      rcases hd with ⟨k, v⟩
      by_cases h : k = key
      · simp [erase, get, h, ih]
      · simp [erase, get, h, ih]

theorem get_erase_ne (m : AssocMap κ α) (key key' : κ) (h : key' ≠ key) :
    get (erase m key) key' = get m key' := by
  induction m with
  | nil =>
      simp [erase, get]
  | cons hd tl ih =>
      rcases hd with ⟨k, v⟩
      by_cases hk : k = key
      · subst hk
        simp [erase, get, h, ih]
      · by_cases hk' : k = key'
        · subst hk'
          simp [erase, get, hk, ih]
        · simp [erase, get, hk, hk', ih]

@[simp] theorem get_put_eq (m : AssocMap κ α) (key : κ) (value : α) :
    get (put m key value) key = some value := by
  simp [put, get]

theorem get_put_ne (m : AssocMap κ α) (key key' : κ) (value : α) (h : key' ≠ key) :
    get (put m key value) key' = get m key' := by
  simp [put, get, h, get_erase_ne (m := m) (key := key) (key' := key') h]

end AssocMap
